source.author: lucan
source.text: Invehit, et summis longe petit aequora remis.
source.text_original: Invehit, et summis longe petit aequora remis.
source.text_english: He drives on, and with his oars raised high he seeks the sea far off.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: breviore petit iam caerula remo occupat et longe sua transtra novissimus Idas.
reuse.text_original: breviore petit iam caerula remo / occupat et longe sua transtra novissimus Idas.
reuse.text_english: With a shorter oar he seeks the blue waters and, last of all, Idas takes his seat far from his own benches.
